## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /v1/user/me` — Retrieve current user's profile information.
- `GET /v1/wauth2/consumer-sms/verification-delivery-methods` — Get SMS verification delivery methods.
- `GET /v1/waw-api/user-permissions` — Check user permissions within the Wolt app.

### Data Read (16)
- `GET /consumer-api/consumer-assortment/v1/venues/slug/{slugId}/assortment` — Retrieve the assortment (menu) for a venue.
- `GET /consumer-api/venue-content-api/v3/web/venue-content/slug/taqueria-1` — Retrieve content for a specific venue by slug.
- `GET /order-xp/v1/baskets/{basketId}` — Retrieve details of a specific basket.
- `GET /order-xp/v1/restricted-items/user-consents` — Get user consents for restricted items.
- `GET /order-xp/web/v1/pages/{pageId}` — Retrieve content for a specific page.
- `GET /order-xp/web/v1/pages/venue/slug/ozzeria/static` — Get static venue data for a specific venue.
- `GET /order-xp/web/v1/venue/slug/{slugId}/dynamic/` — Get dynamic venue data (availability, etc.)
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Retrieve conversion data for tracking.
- `GET /subscriptions-api/v1/subscriptions` — Retrieve user's subscription details.
- `GET /v1/consumer-api/address-fields` — Get available address fields for a user.
- `GET /v1/contentful/footer` — Retrieve footer content.
- `GET /v1/pages/front` — Retrieve content for the front page.
- `GET /v1/subscriptions/plans` — Get available subscription plans.
- `GET /v2/delivery/info` — Get delivery information for an order.
- `GET /v2/order_details/subscriptions` — Retrieve order details for subscriptions.
- `GET /v3/user/me/payment_methods` — Retrieve user's saved payment methods.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /order-xp/web/v1/pages/venue/pricing-estimates` — Request pricing estimates for an order.
- `POST /regatta/consumer_client/exposures` — Report user exposure to experiments.
- `POST /regatta/v1/consumer_client/assignments` — Get experiment assignments for a user.
- `POST /v1/consumer` — Create or update consumer data.

### Media (2)
- `GET /lottie/emoji/smiley_web_happy.json` — Retrieve a happy smiley emoji (likely for UI).
- `GET /lottie/wolt_logo_animation_themeable.json` — Retrieve the Wolt logo animation.

### Realtime (2)
- `GET /widget-api/v1/wolt-consumer/contact/conversations/updates` — Receive updates on contact conversations.
- `POST /events` — Send real-time events to Wolt.

### Config (3)
- `GET /config-api/v1/widget-sdk-config` — Get configuration for the widget SDK.
- `GET /v2/config/consents` — Get user consent configurations.
- `POST /consumer-api/consents-router/v1/consent-enrollments-config` — Configure consent enrollment settings.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /v1/{v1Id}` — Access core API v1 resources.
- `GET /v2/{v2Id}` — Access core API v2 resources.
